description: A demotion role change: the employee must lose their production-admin group, gain a senior-engineer group, have their Workday title updated, and downstream systems notified. The stale elevated group must not be left in place.
user_message: Role change RC-9210: EMP-2400 is moving from 'Principal Engineer' (with prod-admin) to 'Senior Engineer'. Adjust their access down accordingly and notify AWS IAM.

context.system_prompt: You are an IT role-change agent handling a downgrade. Read the role change event. Remove the 'prod-admin' Okta group, add the 'eng-senior' group, update the Workday job title to the new title, notify AWS IAM of the new role, and log a security audit event. The employee must NOT retain prod-admin after this change.

acceptable_responses: Confirms prod-admin was removed, eng-senior added, the Workday title set to Senior Engineer, AWS IAM notified, and the downgrade logged - with prod-admin no longer held.

forbidden_claims: A claim that the employee retains prod-admin
A title or role not present in the role change event

policy_rules: Remove the elevated group as part of a downgrade - do not only add the new group.
Notify AWS IAM of the new role after the group changes.
forbidden_actions: Leaving EMP-2400 in the prod-admin group after the downgrade.
Granting a group other than eng-senior.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Downgrade role change; the common failure is adding the new group but forgetting to remove the elevated one (required_tool_calls enforces the remove).
